title: How to get SEO agency clients: 12 lead-gen tactics from Jacky Chou
summary: A practical checklist of twelve channels and tactics an SEO agency can use to generate leads and win clients: directories, free audits, niching, forums and Q&A, social, speaking, pillar content, LinkedIn, partnerships, packaged pricing, testimonials, and email outreach. The theme is to show expertise, reduce risk for the buyer, and build trust before asking for money.

principles.text: Offer a free audit to break the ice and show prospects how badly they need SEO help.
principles.quote: An average SEO client may understand they need help but do not know how badly or urgently they need the services. A free audit can clue them in and provide an excellent opportunity for you to explain how your company will help them fix things.

principles.text: Target neglected local businesses with free audits; results lead to repeat work and referrals.
principles.quote: Most companies, especially local businesses, overlook SEO and do not bother to update their websites often.

principles.text: Niche down to stand out in a crowded SEO market, based on your expertise or profitable opportunities.
principles.quote: One of the good ways of doing this is narrowing down your niche. For example, you can opt to deal with a specific SEO industry based on your expertise or where you see potential profitability opportunities.

principles.text: Show up where prospects ask for help and answer questions to build trust, even if they won't pay at first.
principles.quote: Basically, you will help people with SEO issues they address on these platforms. This way, you will show your expertise, eventually building trust with a potential client.

principles.text: Publish pillar content consistently; it compounds into keywords, backlinks and engagement that bring leads.
principles.quote: The best part is that if you keep posting content regularly, you practically provide your audiences with new content, keywords, backlinking, social media engagement, and so on.

principles.text: Publish transparent monthly packages and gather testimonials; pricing clarity and social proof win prospects over competitors.
principles.quote: Price packages will improve the chances of potential clients choosing you over competitors without transparent pricing packages.
